inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.constructor.options
inputs.description: Required hosted transport and read configuration; origin must be an exact HTTPS origin or an HTTP loopback origin, and credentials supplies the native credential checked for that origin and principal. Fetch, authority-version and denial hooks, projection cache, and cache-status callback are optional; callback and cache-instance fields cannot be represented in JSON.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.evidence.input
inputs.description: Identifies the hosted evidence read by project, unit, source commit, branch, and current-tip or commit-comparison mode. The answer is accepted only when those bindings match the query.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.artifact.input
inputs.description: Identifies one before or after capture by the evidence record, scenario, state, evidence name, viewport, content hash, and pinned notes/evidence revisions. It supplies no file path; the hosted adapter locates and validates the bytes from this binding.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.agent.method
inputs.description: Names the method sent to the hosted project-agent endpoint. The adapter treats startRun, approve, and openThread as revision-changing methods that require a previously shown writable branch tip; other method strings are sent without that revision.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.agent.input
inputs.description: Payload passed through to the hosted agent call and JSON-serialized in its request body. The adapter does not validate a general payload schema; startRun payloads are also used to identify retries.
inputs.unknownReason: Agent channels have different request shapes, and the selected hosted operation validates its payload.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.agent.projectId
inputs.description: Hosted project identifier used to scope and route the agent request. It is URL-encoded for the agent endpoint.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.onRunEvent.listener
inputs.description: Callback registered to receive RunEvent values polled for active agent runs. Passing a callback is required; JSON cannot express it.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.snapshot.input
inputs.description: Selects a hosted project snapshot at the requested branch and commit; null branch or commit values are omitted from the request query. A commit-pinned or non-tip snapshot is not writable by this adapter.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.entity.input
inputs.description: Selects one entity at a required source commit within a hosted project. The adapter uses the branch remembered from the project's snapshot when forming the read.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.source.input
inputs.description: Selects source text for one repository-relative path, entity, and source commit in a hosted project. The returned path must equal the requested path and the response text must be a string.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.image.input
inputs.description: Selects one image by entity, source commit, design version, and expected SHA-256. The version/hash pair must be anchored by that entity, and the decoded image is limited to 25,000,000 bytes.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.messages.input
inputs.description: Selects messages for a hosted thread by project, entity, source commit, and thread id. The response is accepted only when it is an array whose messages have string ids and text.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.history.input
inputs.description: Selects one history page for an entity at a source commit; page is required and branch optionally scopes the request. The response must contain valid history entries and a consistent completion cursor.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.capabilities.projectId
inputs.description: Identifies the hosted project whose role and executor availability determine its capabilities. Project identifiers are checked while building the hosted API path.

inputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.addComment.input
inputs.description: Carries the project, request id, optional existing thread id, exact anchor, and comment text to post. The acknowledgment must match the project, supplied thread when present, anchor fields, request id, text, and verified principal.

examples.text: Please review this hosted project change.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.evidence
outputs.description: Returns the validated hosted evidence answer, including its requested scope, source/cache identity, evidence sides, and behavior summary. The adapter checks the answer's schema and query bindings; sealed-record validation remains the server's responsibility.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.artifact
outputs.description: Returns the checked capture bytes, media type, and SHA-256 from the hosted artifact cache path. The hosted artifact path is capped at 11 MiB, and its Uint8Array bytes cannot be represented exactly in JSON.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.agent
outputs.description: Returns the hosted endpoint's JSON response without a general response schema. For startRun, the adapter reads its runId and uses it to poll and dispatch run events.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.onRunEvent
outputs.description: Returns an unsubscribe callback; invoking it removes the listener and returns whether the listener was present. The callback itself cannot be represented in JSON.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.available
outputs.description: Resolves to whether the credentials provider returned a credential value; it does not verify the session with the hosted service.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.listProjects
outputs.description: Returns the authenticated principal's hosted projects as shared project summaries. Each returned item contains only id, name, and kind.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.snapshot
outputs.description: Returns the hosted snapshot with capabilities read for the project and writable set only when the request is not commit-pinned, the revision is at its tip, and agents are available. An offline cached snapshot is returned read-only without that additional capability read.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.entity
outputs.description: Returns the hosted entity detail for the requested entity id. Validation checks the id and that versions, sources, and threads are arrays; other entity fields pass through.

examples.title: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter
examples.summary: Reads project data and agent operations over hosted HTTP.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.source
outputs.description: Returns the requested repository-relative path and its hosted text after checking the path matches and text is a string.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.image
outputs.description: Returns decoded image bytes only after the entity contains the requested version/SHA-256 anchor and the bytes match that hash. Images larger than 25,000,000 bytes are rejected; Uint8Array bytes cannot be represented exactly in JSON.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.messages
outputs.description: Returns the hosted thread's message array after checking that each item has a string id and text. Other message fields are passed through by the response validator.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.history
outputs.type: Promise<{ entries: HistoryEvent[]; complete: boolean; nextPage: number | null; }>
outputs.description: Returns a validated history page with entries, a boolean completion state, and nextPage set to null or an integer of at least one. Each entry is checked for string id and title; its other fields pass through.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.capabilities
outputs.description: Resolves to the hosted project capabilities derived from its owner, writer, commenter, or viewer role and executor availability. The result always includes comments, agents, planning, approval, source, and a reason.

examples.reason: Write access: comments and AI requests.

outputs.name: RemoteHttpProjectAdapter.addComment
outputs.description: Returns the acknowledged committed thread after checking its project, optional requested thread id, anchor, comment request id and text, and verified actor identity.

comments.text: Please review this hosted project change.

errors.name: Hosted project access or response validation failure
errors.description: The adapter and its delegated validators reject with standard Error values for hosted authorization or request failures, invalid or mismatched hosted responses, unknown image anchors, or agent mutations without a shown writable branch tip. HTTP failures are normalized by HostedFailureValidator, which extends Error.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: During construction, HostedHttpAdapter passes origin to new URL; malformed URL syntax can throw TypeError before the adapter is created.

errors.description: Rejects when hosted access or authority checks fail, or when the hosted evidence is invalid or bound to another query. An offline read also rejects if no accepted cached answer is available.
